concerns.text: FR-005 and Plan.md (Phase 2) mandate a multivariate model including 'Time_of_Death' and 'PMI' as covariates. Task T035 explicitly lists predictors as 'Gene_Expression + Age + Sex + Tissue', omitting 'Time_of_Death' and 'PMI'. This missing task logic prevents satisfying FR-005.

FR-009 requires reporting odds ratios for 'individual metabolic traits (BMI, glucose, etc.)' alongside gene expression ORs. Task T037 only describes extracting ORs for the predictors defined in T035 (genes + covariates). There is no task to run a separate model or extract trait-specific ORs to satisfy FR-009.

FR-007 requires applying Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction 'independently' to correlation p-values. Task T026 applies FDR to 'all p-values' (implied union of DE and correlation). No separate task exists to run an independent FDR correction specifically for the correlation matrix, risking violation of FR-007.

FR-003 and Plan.md require excluding tissues with <20 samples/group before running Wilcoxon tests. Tasks T024 (stratify) and T025 (run tests) lack a specific sub-task or logic description to implement the sample-count check and exclusion step, risking execution on underpowered tissues.

SC-005 requires sensitivity analysis where ATP-III thresholds are varied by ±5%. Task T042 describes varying thresholds by '30 * 1.05' (multiplicative increase of the threshold value). This logic may not match the spec's intent of varying the criteria or thresholds by ±5% relative to the biological standard. Additionally, the task depends on 'filtered_phenotype.csv' which is mentioned in T014's output description but not explicitly generated as a distinct artifact in the dependency chain, creating a potential missing artifact link.

Plan.md Phase 0 includes a research action to 'Inspect GTEx v8 schema... to confirm presence of [variables]' before download. Task T010 jumps straight to downloading. There is no task corresponding to the pre-download verification step, risking a download of a dataset that fails the column check (T011) after the fact.

FR-001 distinguishes between 'missing columns' and 'low sample size (N<100)'. Task T011 sets status to 'Exploratory - Insufficient Phenotype Data' if columns are missing, which conflates the two distinct failure modes defined in FR-001. This is a labeling/writing issue in the task description.
